body.name: quadratic-endpoint heavy-tail witness \(P^{\star}\)
body.construction: Under \(P^{\star}\), let \(X\sim\mathrm{Unif}[0,1]\), \(\pi_1(x)=0.4+0.2x\), \(\lambda_a(t,x)=1+a/2+x/4\), and \(g_a(t,x)=\exp(-xt/4)\); generate conditionally independent potential event times with these hazards and censoring times with survival \((1-t)^2g_a(t,x)\), and set the observed variables by consistency.
